name: An ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure

meaning.zh:
“一分预防胜过十分治疗” 或 “预防胜于治疗”。

这个谚语的字面意思是：一盎司的预防比一磅的治疗更有价值。它的核心观念是提前采取预防措施可以减少之后处理问题的麻烦和成本。这个谚语的出现被认为可以追溯到古代，但是在18世纪，由本杰明·富兰克林特别在关于火灾安全的演讲中广泛传播。他提到，预防火灾的重要性远远大于事后补救。
meaning.en: The literal meaning of this proverb is: an ounce of prevention is worth more than a pound of cure. The core idea is that taking preventative measures in advance can reduce the trouble and cost of dealing with issues later on. The idiom is believed to date back to ancient times, but it was popularized by Benjamin Franklin in the 18th century, especially in his speech about fire safety, emphasizing that preventing fires is much more important than dealing with the aftermath.

lines.en: She always follows the saying "an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure" by keeping her house well-maintained.
lines.zh: 她总是遵循 “预防胜于治疗” 的原则，保持房子的良好维护。

lines.en: Vaccinations are a great example of how an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure.
lines.zh: 疫苗接种就是 “预防胜于治疗” 的一个很好的例子。

lines.en: By saving money regularly, he proves that an ounce of prevention is worth a pound of cure for financial stability.
lines.zh: 通过定期储蓄，他证明预防胜于治疗对于财务稳定性来讲是切实有效的。
